scope: Local current-state predicate representation diagnosis only. No full world model or planner.
plan: Audit actual cached inputs, active labels and entity mapping on train/C dev before training.
Run three fixed input perturbations on C development only; report OOD limitations, not causal proof.
If audit confirms discarded explicit pair information and no implementation error, run one minimal generic visible-mask pair reader, with appearance-only capacity-matched control.

Use unchanged joint C selection/calibration. Freeze qualifying candidates before any new12-root one-shot acceptance; no collection if fewer than2/3 qualified seeds or no dev evidence over baseline/control.

evidence_rules.test_use: old D, previous38test and previous83acceptance are history only, never input to architecture choice, tuning or selection.
evidence_rules.perturbation: Feature substitutions are OOD interventions, only indicate sensitivity; no assertion of unique causal use.
evidence_rules.label_audit: Check active core1200_collect.label pipeline, contact-supported ownership and image identity. Preserve records; do not silently relabel.
evidence_rules.representation: DINO can retain positional context in embeddings; averaging ROI cells removes their explicit order but does not prove all spatial information or relation ability is absent.

conditional_minimal_comparison.base: Previous balanced-loss reader, same original900+supplement73 target held/in/open masks and loss weights.
conditional_minimal_comparison.appearance_control: Add generic target-to-visible-mask attention with frozen pooled DINO appearance, same parameter count as relational arm; relative geometry input zeroed.
conditional_minimal_comparison.relational_arm: Same module plus public pixel bbox relative offsets, size ratios, overlap/containment and mask visibility. No simulator object positions, contact labels, environment IDs, numerical instance IDs, or semantic container IDs in network input.
conditional_minimal_comparison.entities: All12 existing visible-mask slots from frozen cache, shared generic encoder; target is existing pixel-colour-registered object. No named drawer slot oracle.
conditional_minimal_comparison.architecture_budget: Small residual pair aggregation into existing object encoding; preserve existing GRUs, shared predicate head, scene head and proprioception.
conditional_minimal_comparison.sampling: Use exactly previous shuffled973-window streams; fresh matched seeds; save all scheduled checkpoint weights.
conditional_minimal_comparison.criterion: Unchanged joint tune180old+37new, calibration120old+37new. Raw each-domain/predicate FPR<=1%, recall>=95%; coverage/effective known recall>=95%.
conditional_minimal_comparison.evidence_to_collect: At least2/3 relational seeds pass full joint dev criteria; relational group must have fewer raw gate failures or lower joint BCE than matched appearance control, without promoting test-best seed. If absent, no extra acceptance collection.

acceptance_if_warranted.design: 3target colours x2drawer settings x2layouts, nativeD; exclude all prior same-environment root families including prior12 acceptance roots.
acceptance_if_warranted.protocol: Same unchanged lift/probe/place collection and QA; no resampling failures.
acceptance_if_warranted.test_once: Freeze model/threshold/roots first, one evaluation, no acceptance-led repair.
